label: Bible Study
prompt: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the _____ also.
verse: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
note: The sun and moon get a whole sentence; the stars get four words tacked on the end — 'he made the stars also.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the _____ of God.
verse: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
note: Faith is the access pass: we stand in grace today and rejoice in hope of glory tomorrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the sun stood still, and the _____ stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verse: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
note: The sun stood still and the moon stayed — a day so long the Bible cites the book of Jasher as a second witness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very _____ with me.
verse: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
note: Naomi means 'pleasant' and Mara 'bitter' — she renamed herself after losing her husband and sons in Moab.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no _____.
verse: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
note: 'Beside me there is no saviour' — the KJV keeps the British u, and God keeps the title for himself.
